parameters.query:
WITH run AS (
  INSERT INTO triage.runs (started) VALUES (now()) RETURNING id
),
cfg AS (
  SELECT body, sha256 FROM triage.config WHERE name = 'config.yaml'
),
-- Same pattern as reposFromConfigLine() in rules.js; the Triage node checks they agree.
repos AS (
  SELECT btrim(r, ' "''') AS repo
  FROM cfg, regexp_split_to_table((regexp_match(E'\n' || cfg.body, '\nrepos:\s*\[([^\]\n]*)\]'))[1], ',') AS r
),
last AS (
  SELECT list_etags FROM triage.runs WHERE finished IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  run.id AS run_id,
  repos.repo,
  (SELECT list_etags ->> repos.repo FROM last) AS list_etag,
  cfg.body AS config_body,
  cfg.sha256 AS config_sha,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(pattern ORDER BY pattern), '[]'::json) FROM triage.redaction_patterns) AS patterns,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(repo || '#' || pr || '@' || head_sha), '[]'::json)
     FROM triage.verdicts WHERE created > now() - interval '90 days') AS seen
FROM run
LEFT JOIN cfg ON true
LEFT JOIN repos ON true;

parameters.query:
UPDATE triage.runs
SET finished = now(),
    pr_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM triage.verdicts WHERE run_id = $1),
    negative_control = $2,
    ok = $3,
    list_etags = $4::jsonb
WHERE id = $1;
